Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the search results snippet and prematurely concluded that Laura Osnes was “only nominated (no win)” for a Drama Desk Award. In reality, Laura Osnes won the 2013 Drama Desk Award for Outstanding Actress in a Musical (Cinderella). The agent relied on a snippet instead of opening and verifying authoritative sources (e.g., Playbill’s winners list) and ignored visible evidence (press room photos of Osnes accepting the award), leading the workflow down an incorrect path.
